open_questions: Malformed UTF-8 follows the Unicode Standard's Table 3-7 except after E0, ED, F0 and F4: a second byte in 80..BF outside the table's range is taken into the U+FFFD (3,072 swept inputs). Whether Windows documents this rule is not established.

GetStringTypeW and LCMapStringW are observed for code page 1252's 256 characters only; w2m stops on any other unit, on LCMapStringW size queries and on locales other than the user default and invariant.
The rows do not record the last error after GetStringTypeW and LCMapStringW; w2m leaves it.
